'''Daruula Grah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. By [[3630 BBY]] he became known as the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]] under the title "Nightmare Weaver". That year, Grah was put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]." During the fight in the Arena, Grah used multiple trained [[Iknayid]]s native to Zakuul, but was defeated in the second round of the Arena fights.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Daruula Grah appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as the second boss of "Eternal Championship".<ref name="SWTOR" />
